d: Nitin Gadkari Big Announcement : bihar men ab nadiyon ki gad se sarken banane ki taiyari hai...kendr sarkar aur bihar sarkar ke bich isko lekar MoU huaa hai... maksad hai nadiyon se gad nikalkar unki jaldharan kshamta barhana aur usi gad ka istemal neshnal haeeve nirman men karna... lekin is pahal par siyasat bhi shuru ho gaee hai... RJD ne bhrashtachar ka aarop lagaya hai, to JDU aur BJP ise bihar ke vikas ki disha men aitihasik kadam bata rahe hain... vahin kangres ne vaigyanik sarve aur barh ke khatre ko lekar saval uthae hain... dekhie ye riport...
